billing.text:
--- title: API Pricing & Costs description: Understand Runway Dev pricing and costs. View rates for Gen-4.5, Seedance, Kling, GPT Image and other models to budget for your AI video integration project. --- Each generation you run on Runway Dev costs credits. Credits can be purchased for $0.01 per credit in the developer portal for a project. Sales tax may apply depending on your location. Create an account (https://dev.runway.com/) to start building on Runway Dev. Generations routed through a Model Router (/model-routers) are billed at the standard rate of whichever model the router selects. The response metadata reports the model used and the realized cost in credits. Video Generation Pricing At 4K, a 5-second Seedance 2.5 generation without video references costs 550 credits ($5.50). Adding 5 seconds of input or reference video makes it 835 credits ($8.35): 5 × 110 + 5 × 57. Image and audio references add no charge. The calculator below estimates output-only costs; add any input and reference video charges separately. Seedance 2.5 draft mode uses these same rates. A preview (draft: true on text to video, image to video, or video to video) bills at the 480p rate. Enhancing that preview to 1080p (draftTaskId on text to video) bills at the 1080p rate for the same output duration and input video. The two calls are charged separately. See draft mode (/guides/models#seedance-25-draft-mode). Seedance 2.5 and Seedance 2.5 Flash outputFormat: "mov" is billed at the same rates as the default mp4. Seedance 2.5 Flash has no draft mode. Seedance 2.0, 2.0 Fast, and 2.0 Mini bill bitrate: "standard" (the default) and bitrate: "high" at the same rates. audio defaults to true. Kling 3.0 Standard and Pro use the no-audio rate when audio is false. Kling 3.0 4K uses the same rate either way. Kling O3 is billed at the rates above whether or not audio is false. Kling O3 video-to-video is billed per second of the input video. Kling 4.0 includes audio and has no audio toggle. Charges are rounded up to the next credit. Through November 30, 2026 UTC, the list-price charge is rounded up, then discounted 20% and rounded up again — a 5 second 720p video without an input video is 64 credits. List prices apply from December 1, 2026 UTC. Input video is a video-to-video source or any reference video. Each input clip counts at most 30 seconds, and the combined input is capped at 30 seconds. A video edit uses the source video's length as the output duration. Professional and HDR output formats These formats add a per-second surcharge on top of the model's rate. Available on Gen-4.5 and Aleph 2.0 — see Professional outputs (/guides/professional-outputs#editorial-containers) for which outputFormat values each model supports. kling_4_flash includes audio at the same price on every endpoint. Input-video duration is the sum of the source and reference clips, with each capped at 20 seconds and a combined 20-second budget. Image references have no separate charge. The total is rounded up once per generation. For example, a 5-second output without input video costs 47 credits; with 3 seconds of input video it costs 63 credits; with 10 seconds of input video it costs 95 credits. The calculator covers only requests without input video. The Kling 4.0 promotion does not apply to Flash. gemini_omni_flash_1.2 defaults to 720p. The total output, image, and input-video charges are rounded up to the next credit, with a 6-credit minimum per request. With duration: "auto", generation and extension reserve 15 seconds of output, then settle to the generated duration rounded up to a whole second (3–15 seconds). Extension bills only the newly added output footage, plus the input video. Editing bills the input video's duration at the output rate, plus the input-video and reference-image charges. The calculator below does not include this model's reference charges or mode-specific billing; use these rates instead. 3D generation pricing Each request generates one GLB mesh. One credit costs $0.01. The cost calculator below does not support 3D generation; use these tables instead. Trellis 2's textureSize, decimationTarget, and remesh settings do not change the price. Tripo H3.1 options Add these charges to the text- or image-input base price: texture and pbr both default to true; PBR enables textures even when texture is false. Texture quality and geometry quality default to standard. Texture quality has no charge when both textures and PBR are disabled. Default requests cost 20 credits ($0.20) from text or 30 credits ($0.30) from images. Detailed textures and detailed geometry together cost 50 credits from text or 60 from images. Additional reference views do not add charges. Hunyuan 3D 3.1 Pro options The default is generateType: "Normal", enablePbr: false, and faceCount: 500000. Geometry-only output (generateType: "Geometry") has the same base price and cannot use PBR. Charges are summed and rounded up once to a whole credit: the underlying 37.5-credit base rounds to 38 credits ($0.38), or 83 credits ($0.83) with all three extras. Image Generation Pricing Grok Imagine Image 2 grok_imagine_image_2 is billed as outputCount × perImage + referenceCount × 1. Reference images cost 1 credit each and are charged once per request, not per output image — for example, four 1K medium images with two references is 4 × 6 + 2 = 26 credits. Default quality is medium; anything other than low (including an omitted quality) bills as medium. auto_1k and auto_2k bill at the 1K and 2K tiers. A plain 1K generation is 6 credits (the minimum charge). With outputCount capped at 4 and references at 3, the maximum for a single request is 35 credits. MiniMax H3 Image minimax_h3_image is billed as outputCount times the credits per image below. auto_1k, auto_2k, and auto_4k use the 1K, 2K, and 4K columns. highspeed defaults to false. The rate of every generated image depends on how many reference images the request has, and adding one reference doesn't always change it. For example, one 2K Highspeed image with 4 reference images is 7 credits, and four text-only 4K images are 28 credits. The cost calculator (#cost-calculator) works this out for any request. Seedream 5.5 seedream5.5 is billed as outputCount × (perImage + referenceCount × 0.8), rounded up to a whole credit per request. auto_1k, auto_1.5k and auto_2k bill at the 1K, 1.5K and 2K rates. For example, four 2K images with two reference images is 4 × (4 + 1.6) = 22.4, charged as 23 credits. Seedream 5.5 Layers seedream5.5_layers is billed per returned image, counting the base image and each layer, plus 0.8 credits for the source image, rounded up to a whole credit. A decomposition reserves credits for maxImages (default 30), then settles to the images returned. With the default, it reserves 61 credits at 1K or 1.5K and 121 credits at 2K or auto. For example, a 2K decomposition that returns a base image and 8 layers costs 37 credits. A task needs enough credits for the full reservation to start, so set a lower maxImages to reserve less. Seedream 5 Pro Layers seedream5_pro_layers is billed per returned image, counting the base image and each layer. A decomposition returns at most 17 images (a base image plus 16 layers), so it reserves 51 credits at 1K or 1.5K and 85 credits at 2K or auto, then settles to the images returned. For example, a 2K decomposition that returns a base image and 8 layers costs 45 credits. A task needs enough credits for the full reservation to start.
